newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania unions say bread price strike successful.
newsitem.headline: Albania unions say bread price strike successful.

text.p: The Albanian government has agreed to look into demands of strikers protesting against rising inflation and higher bread prices, a trade union official said on Tuesday.
"The strike achieved its aim," Estref Mersinaj of the Independent Trade Union (ITU) told Reuters.

Up to 200,000 public sector workers took part in Monday's nationwide protests to press for compensation after President Sali Berisha's government liberalised prices of bread, gas and kerosene prices in July.
The strike came just a month ahead of Albanian local elections scheduled for October 20.
The ITU, which organised the protest with the Confederation of Albanian Trade Unions, said it planned another one-day strike on October 4.
Bread prices have been a sensitive issue since Albania toppled its hardline communist regime in 1990. More than 40 people were killed in a wave of food riots in 1991.
